chunks: So glorify your Lord, the Magnificent.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to glorify the Lord in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Prophet Muhammad and the Ahl al-Bayt, with 'Al-'Azeem' (The Great) interpreted as a reference to Imam Ali or the divine attribute of greatness. It serves as a spiritual anchor for believers, encouraging constant remembrance (dhikr) to maintain humility and awareness of Allah's majesty amidst worldly affairs.
